children.label: b
children.prompt: What is the bearing of $C$ from $X$, to the nearest degree?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\cos\angle PXC &= \frac{7.5}{40}\\\angle PXC &= \cos^{-1}\!\left(\frac{7.5}{40}\right)\end{align*}$$
$C$ is west of south from $X$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Bearing} &= 180^\circ+\cos^{-1}\!\left(\frac{7.5}{40}\right)\\&\approx259^\circ\end{align*}$$
